title: TOPTOY international shop labels five distinct blind-box series 'Releasing Nov 20'
summary: On November 21, the TOPTOY international, US-focused new-arrivals page labeled five series 'Releasing Nov 20': Nommi Gummy Plan limited-edition mini-figure phone charms (ONE BOX $10.00; separate 6-box set), MayMei x tokidoki plush blind boxes (ONE BOX $26.99; separate 6-box set), Sanrio Hello Kitty and Friends Knock Knock Lucky plush charms (ONE BOX $26.99; separate 8-box set), Crayon Shin-chan Meme pendants (ONE BOX $10.00; separate 9-box set), and Disney Cowboy Knights clock-figure blind boxes (ONE BOX $23.99; separate 6-box set). These are displayed dollar asking prices for the ONE BOX (random) selections on exact series pages; set totals were not verified and must not be inferred by multiplication. The selected one-box offer pages showed in-stock/Add to cart for MayMei and Hello Kitty, and out-of-stock/Sold out for Nommi, Shin-chan and Disney at this limited check; these statuses do not establish all variants' or locations' availability. The November 20 date is the retailer's release label, not a verified original mainland launch or proof of sales. Do not import unrelated accessories or attribute licensed Sanrio/Disney/Crayon Shin-chan characters to a China-origin IP. No new catalog additions are claimed in this editorial check.
